    ParentProcessName = iif(_hasTarget, _parent, ''),
    ParentProcessId = iif(_hasTarget, tostring(tolong(process.parent.pid)), ''),
    ActorUsername = case(isnotempty(tostring(process.username)), tostring(process.username), user_name),
    ActorUsernameType = case(isempty(user_name), '', user_name has '@', 'UPN', user_name contains '\\', 'Windows', 'Simple'),
    TargetUsername = case(_hasTarget and isnotempty(tostring(process.target.username)), tostring(process.target.username), isnotempty(tostring(process.username)), tostring(process.username), user_name),
    TargetUsernameType = case(isempty(user_name), '', user_name has '@', 'UPN', user_name contains '\\', 'Windows', 'Simple'),
    AdditionalFields = pack('AbstractEventId', tostring(['id']), 'AbstractCategory', tostring(event.category), 'AbstractDataset', tostring(data_stream.dataset), 'AbstractMatchedRules', matched_rules)

routes.name: RegistryEvent
routes.transformKql:
source
| where tolower(case(isnotempty(acs_type), acs_type, tostring(['type']))) !in ('finding', 'alert')
| where isnotempty(tostring(registry.path)) or isnotempty(tostring(registry.key))
| extend _verb = tolower(tostring(action))
| where isnotempty(_verb) and not(_verb contains 'read' or _verb contains 'query' or _verb startswith 'get' or _verb contains 'open' or _verb contains 'enum')
| extend _action = tolower(tostring(action)), _outcome = tolower(tostring(event.outcome)), _sev = tolower(case(isnotempty(severity), severity, tostring(event.severity)))
| extend _result = case(_outcome in ('success', 'succeeded', 'allowed', 'allow'), 'Success', _outcome in ('failure', 'failed', 'fail', 'denied', 'blocked', 'deny'), 'Failure', _outcome == 'partial', 'Partial', 'NA')
| extend _time = case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now())
| where _time > ago(2d)
| project
    TimeGenerated = _time,
    EventCount = iif(isnull(aggregation_count) or aggregation_count < 1, toint(1), toint(aggregation_count)),
    EventStartTime = case(isnotnull(todatetime(event.start)), todatetime(event.start), isnotnull(aggregation_start), aggregation_start, _time),
    EventEndTime = case(isnotnull(todatetime(event.end)), todatetime(event.end), isnotnull(aggregation_end), aggregation_end, _time),
    EventResult = _result,
    EventOriginalResultDetails = tostring(event.reason),
    EventOriginalType = tostring(action),
    EventOriginalUid = case(isnotempty(tostring(event.id)), tostring(event.id), tostring(['id'])),
    EventSeverity = case(_sev in ('critical', 'high'), 'High', _sev in ('medium', 'warn', 'warning'), 'Medium', _result == 'Failure' or _sev in ('low', 'error'), 'Low', 'Informational'),
    EventOriginalSeverity = case(isnotempty(severity), severity, tostring(event.severity)),
    EventMessage = message,
    EventProduct = product,
    EventVendor = vendor,
    EventSchemaVersion = '0.1.2',
    EventSchema = 'RegistryEvent',
    DvcHostname = host_name,
    DvcIpAddr = case(isnotempty(host_ipv4), host_ipv4, host_ipv6),
    EventType = case(_action contains 'delet' and isnotempty(tostring(registry.value)), 'RegistryValueDeleted', _action contains 'delet', 'RegistryKeyDeleted', _action contains 'renam', 'RegistryKeyRenamed', _action contains 'creat' and isempty(tostring(registry.value)), 'RegistryKeyCreated', 'RegistryValueSet'),
    RegistryKey = case(isnotempty(tostring(registry.path)), tostring(registry.path), strcat(tostring(registry.hive), '\\', tostring(registry.key))),
    RegistryValue = tostring(registry.value),
    RegistryValueType = tostring(registry.data.type),
    RegistryValueData = case(array_length(registry.data.strings) > 0, tostring(registry.data.strings[0]), tostring(registry.data.bytes)),
    ActorUsername = user_name,
    ActorUsernameType = case(isempty(user_name), '', user_name has '@', 'UPN', user_name contains '\\', 'Windows', 'Simple'),
    ActingProcessName = case(isnotempty(tostring(process.executable)), tostring(process.executable), tostring(process.name)),
    ActingProcessId = tostring(tolong(process.pid)),
    AdditionalFields = pack('AbstractEventId', tostring(['id']), 'AbstractCategory', tostring(event.category), 'AbstractDataset', tostring(data_stream.dataset), 'AbstractMatchedRules', matched_rules)

routes.name: WebSession
routes.transformKql:
source
| where tolower(case(isnotempty(acs_type), acs_type, tostring(['type']))) !in ('finding', 'alert')
| extend _category = tolower(tostring(event.category))
| where _category has 'web' or (isnotempty(tostring(url.original)) and isnotempty(tostring(http.request.method)))
| extend _status = toint(http.response.status_code)
| extend _action = tolower(tostring(action)), _outcome = tolower(tostring(event.outcome)), _sev = tolower(case(isnotempty(severity), severity, tostring(event.severity)))
| extend _result = case(_outcome in ('success', 'succeeded', 'allowed', 'allow'), 'Success', _outcome in ('failure', 'failed', 'fail', 'denied', 'blocked', 'deny'), 'Failure', _outcome == 'partial', 'Partial', 'NA')
| extend _time = case(isnotnull(['timestamp']), ['timestamp'], isnotnull(ingested_time), ingested_time, now())
| where _time > ago(2d)
| project
    TimeGenerated = _time,
    EventCount = iif(isnull(aggregation_count) or aggregation_count < 1, toint(1), toint(aggregation_count)),
    EventStartTime = case(isnotnull(todatetime(event.start)), todatetime(event.start), isnotnull(aggregation_start), aggregation_start, _time),
    EventEndTime = case(isnotnull(todatetime(event.end)), todatetime(event.end), isnotnull(aggregation_end), aggregation_end, _time),
    EventResult = case(isnotnull(_status) and _status >= 400, 'Failure', isnotnull(_status), 'Success', _result),
    EventOriginalResultDetails = tostring(event.reason),
    EventOriginalType = tostring(action),
    EventOriginalUid = case(isnotempty(tostring(event.id)), tostring(event.id), tostring(['id'])),
    EventSeverity = case(_sev in ('critical', 'high'), 'High', _sev in ('medium', 'warn', 'warning'), 'Medium', case(isnotnull(_status) and _status >= 400, 'Failure', isnotnull(_status), 'Success', _result) == 'Failure' or _sev in ('low', 'error'), 'Low', 'Informational'),
    EventOriginalSeverity = case(isnotempty(severity), severity, tostring(event.severity)),
    EventMessage = message,
    EventProduct = product,
    EventVendor = vendor,
    EventSchemaVersion = '0.2.6',
    DvcHostname = host_name,
    Dvc = case(isnotempty(host_name), host_name, isnotempty(host_ipv4), host_ipv4, isnotempty(product), product, vendor),
    DvcIpAddr = case(isnotempty(host_ipv4), host_ipv4, host_ipv6),
    EventType = 'HTTPsession',
    EventResultDetails = tostring(_status),
    Url = tostring(url.original),
    HttpRequestMethod = toupper(tostring(http.request.method)),
    HttpVersion = tostring(http.version),
    HttpReferrer = tostring(http.request.referrer),
    HttpContentType = tostring(http.response.mime_type),
    HttpUserAgent = user_agent,
    SrcIpAddr = case(isnotempty(source_ipv4), source_ipv4, isnotempty(source_ipv6), source_ipv6, source_address matches regex '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+$', source_address, ''),
    DstIpAddr = case(isnotempty(dest_ipv4), dest_ipv4, isnotempty(dest_ipv6), dest_ipv6, dest_address matches regex '^[0-9a-fA-F:.]+$', dest_address, ''),
    SrcPortNumber = toint(source_port),
    DstPortNumber = toint(dest_port),
    DstHostname = tostring(destination.domain),
    SrcUsername = user_name,
    SrcUsernameType = case(isempty(user_name), '', user_name has '@', 'UPN', user_name contains '\\', 'Windows', 'Simple'),
    SrcBytes = tolong(http.request.bytes),
    DstBytes = tolong(http.response.bytes),
    DvcAction = case(_action in ('allow', 'allowed', 'accept', 'accepted', 'permit', 'pass') or _outcome in ('allow', 'allowed'), 'Allow', _action in ('deny', 'denied', 'block', 'blocked', 'reject', 'rejected') or _outcome in ('deny', 'denied', 'blocked'), 'Deny', _action in ('drop', 'dropped'), 'Drop', ''),
    AdditionalFields = pack('AbstractEventId', tostring(['id']), 'AbstractCategory', tostring(event.category), 'AbstractDataset', tostring(data_stream.dataset), 'AbstractMatchedRules', matched_rules)
